name: oh-my-knowledge
description: A local, git-versioned knowledge base for Claude Code: look up, distill, lint and hand off durable knowledge instead of letting it rot in auto memory.

knowledge_dir.title: Knowledge base directory
knowledge_dir.description: Local folder (a git repo) that holds the knowledge base. Must not contain a single quote. Run the setup skill after changing it.

lookup_reminder.title: Lookup reminder
lookup_reminder.description: On each prompt that looks like a problem or error, remind Claude to search the knowledge base before answering.

auto_handoff.title: Automatic handoff
auto_handoff.description: When context usage reaches the threshold, ask Claude to run a handoff automatically.

auto_handoff_threshold.title: Automatic handoff threshold (%)
auto_handoff_threshold.description: Context usage percentage at which the automatic handoff triggers.

auto_handoff_repeat.title: Automatic handoff repeat (percentage points)
auto_handoff_repeat.description: Once a handoff was requested at or above the threshold, ask again after usage has grown by this many points.

lint_stale_days.title: Lint: stale after (days)
lint_stale_days.description: A page whose verified date is older than this is reported as stale by lint.

lint_flag_days.title: Lint: flag review window (days)
lint_flag_days.description: An UNVERIFIED flag older than this many days is reported as overdue (unverified_overdue).

lint_remind_after_distills.title: Lint reminder: after N distills
lint_remind_after_distills.description: Remind to run lint after this many distill runs since the last lint.

max_file_kb.title: Max page size (KB)
max_file_kb.description: Topic pages and sub-indexes larger than this are flagged for splitting.

max_index_line_chars.title: Max index line length (characters)
max_index_line_chars.description: Index lines longer than this many characters (not bytes) are flagged.
